exposure: Bishop score at the time of amniotomy after Foley balloon catheter removal (favorable Bishop score ≥ 6 vs. unfavorable Bishop score < 6)
cohort: Women with singleton-term pregnancies who underwent cervical ripening using a Foley balloon catheter for labor induction at Taixing People's Hospital from January 2023 to July 2023.
finding: Amniotomy performed with a favorable Bishop score (≥ 6) after Foley balloon catheter removal for labor induction is associated with lower cesarean delivery rates, shorter induction-to-delivery intervals, and less postdelivery hemoglobin decline without increasing adverse maternal or neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: A favorable Bishop score at amniotomy was linked to significantly lower cesarean delivery rates, with no significant difference in operative vaginal delivery rates.
